mapper.insert: INSERT INTO menu_recipe (title, recipe_date, issue, canteen_name, group_id, is_current, creator_id) VALUES (#{title}, #{recipeDate}, #{issue}, #{canteenName}, #{groupId}, COALESCE(#{isCurrent}, 0), #{creatorId})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM menu_recipe WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE menu_recipe SET is_deleted = 1, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM menu_recipe WHERE group_id = #{groupId} AND is_current = 1 AND is_deleted = 0 LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE menu_recipe SET is_current = 0, updated_at = NOW() WHERE group_id = #{groupId} AND is_current = 1 AND is_deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM menu_recipe WHERE recipe_date = #{date} AND is_deleted = 0 AND status != 'generated' LIMIT 1
SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM menu_recipe WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND group_id = #{groupId} GROUP BY status

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(recipe_date, '%Y-%m') AS month, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM menu_recipe WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND group_id = #{groupId} AND recipe_date >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{months} MONTH) GROUP BY month ORDER BY month ASC
